description: Solar Electricity for Community Buildings Program is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Successful applicants of the 2017-2019 Solar for Community Buildings Program, that enables eligible community groups and organizations to generate solar photovoltaic (PV) electricity on their roofs or properties. Coverage: Government of Nova Scotia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Nova Scotia | Gouvernment de la Nouvelle-Écosse. Its tags are renewable energy, solar energy, energy generation, Government information, énergie renouvelable. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Nova Scotia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
